subject: Renewal QBR — condensed demo window and recording custody
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@brightbeamhealth.com>, Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@brightbeamhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR — condensed demo window and recording custody

Hi Liam / Ana,

Hope you had a great week. As we prep for your renewal QBR and roadmap demo, suggested approach to keep this tight for your execs: a 75–90 minute condensed session that covers: renewal commercial recap (10 min), roadmap highlights (20), targeted technical deep-dive (25), and Q&A + next steps (20).

Two asks from our side before we lock the invite:
- Confirm if BrightBeam needs the session recorded and whether recording will be retained by you or Redwoods for contract/regulatory traceability.
- Any hard exec blackout windows next week (we heard one of your VPs is traveling).

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 18 May — 11:00–12:30
- Wed 19 May — 14:00–15:30
- Thu 20 May — 08:30–10:00

I've attached a compact agenda and a preliminary mutual action plan so we can align on owners/time-to-sign. If you're good with one of those slots I can send a calendar invite and add the recording preference as an item in the MAP.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-1842

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF stub), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@brightbeamhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@brightbeamhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — condensed demo window and recording custody

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear plan. We definitely prefer the condensed format. A couple quick notes: 

1) Exec availability: our VP of Data (Jared Kim) is out Tues-Wed on site. Thu morning looks most promising. Can you do Thu 08:30–10:00 PT?
2) Recording: regulator preference is that BrightBeam retains recordings for audit (we can provide secure S3 access). So please plan to mark the recording as BrightBeam-owned. If Redwood needs a short-term copy for post-demo follow-up, we'll allow it for 7 days only.
3) Procurement: our procurement lead (Ana) asked if we can get a one-page summary of renewal terms and the PO process before the call.

If that works we'll confirm and Ana will send the attendee list.

Best,
Liam
